patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: My breathing's been getting worse for two days — more wheezy, coughing up yellow stuff. I'm a longtime smoker with emphysema. My rescue inhaler barely helps now.
presentation.triageNote: 66-year-old male with COPD and two days of worsening breathlessness, wheeze, and increased yellow sputum. His rescue inhaler is barely helping; he uses accessory muscles, breathes 26/min, and has oxygen saturation 88%.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because worsening breathlessness with accessory-muscle use, respiratory rate 26, oxygen saturation 88%, and poor inhaler response is a high-risk respiratory presentation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient with chronic lung disease has increased work of breathing, wheeze, sputum change, and significant hypoxemia.
clinical.acuityReason: Accessory-muscle use and poor response to rescue medication indicate risk of fatigue and deterioration even if the oxygen value may overlap an individualized chronic target.
expectedResources: Chest X-ray, ECG, and laboratory testing
teachingPoints: Oxygen should be titrated to the patient's clinical state and appropriate target rather than withheld.
Diminishing wheeze with fatigue or reduced air movement may indicate worsening obstruction.

possibleDiagnoses: Acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive lung disease
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Rapid respiratory treatment and diagnostic evaluation would likely lead to observation or admission unless work of breathing and oxygenation return safely to baseline.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: leaning forward, hands on knees, pursed-lip breathing
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 66-year-old man, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: leaning forward with hands on his knees, pursed-lip breathing. Expression: tired and working to breathe. Clearly visible: a forward-leaning tripod posture and effortful breathing. No text, no logos.
